categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a commercial bank offering deposit and loan services, wealth management, trust services, securities brokerage, and digital financial services. It also engages in overseas banking operations and investment in financial assets. The bank supports corporate clients, SMEs, and individual customers with a focus on sustainable finance and green loans.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank utilizes advanced financial technologies including AI for fraud detection, robotic process automation (RPA) for operational efficiency, big data analytics for customer segmentation and credit risk assessment, and digital platforms for online banking and mobile payments. It maintains robust IT infrastructure with mainframe and open system servers, storage area networks, and comprehensive cybersecurity measures certified by ISO standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual retail clients, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), corporate clients, and high-net-worth individuals for wealth management. The bank serves domestic markets extensively and also targets international markets through overseas branches and subsidiaries, focusing on financial services for Taiwanese businesses and global trade participants.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank operates extensively across Taiwan with 185 domestic branches and over 600 ATMs. It has international presence with branches in major financial centers including New York, Los Angeles, Tokyo (and Osaka), London, Hong Kong, Singapore, Manila, and a representative office in Yangon. It also operates a subsidiary commercial bank in China with branches in multiple cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment of the financial services supply chain, directly providing banking, trust, wealth management, and brokerage services to end customers. It also acts as a financial intermediary facilitating capital flow between depositors and borrowers, and participates in securities underwriting and investment activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core banking and corporate finance, expanding digital financial services with AI and big data, enhancing wealth management capabilities, and promoting sustainable finance aligned with ESG principles. R&D focuses on fintech innovation, digital platform upgrades, AI-driven fraud prevention, and green finance product development to support low-carbon transition and regulatory compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through interest income from loans, fee income from wealth management, trust services, credit card operations, and brokerage commissions. Additional income streams include investment gains from securities holdings and service fees from digital financial products. The bank also earns from insurance agency services and overseas banking operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The bank competes with other Taiwanese commercial banks, including state-owned and private institutions, as well as emerging digital-only banks and fintech firms. It positions itself as a well-established, reputable bank with a strong domestic network and growing international footprint, emphasizing sustainable finance and digital innovation as competitive differentiators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the bank reported total assets exceeding NT$3.17 trillion, with net profit after tax of approximately NT$14.95 billion, reflecting a 15.12% growth over the previous year. Deposits and loans grew by over 9% and 10% respectively. The bank maintains strong capital adequacy and asset quality, with a low non-performing loan ratio and high coverage ratio, indicating stable financial health and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The bank offers comprehensive financial services with a focus on customer-centricity, sustainability, and innovation. It differentiates through extensive branch and ATM networks, bilingual services, advanced digital platforms, and specialized products such as green loans, trust services for wealth transfer, and AI-enhanced fraud prevention. Its commitment to ESG and corporate governance enhances trust and long-term value for customers and stakeholders.
